write_up: Your resume tells a familiar story: you moved from marketing assistant at Fernwood Coffee Roasters to marketing coordinator at Juniper Outdoor Co., working across email, events and social media. The work is recognizable, but most lines stop at the task, and nothing accounts for the time after March 2024. Together, those gaps make it less likely to stand out in a pile.

The weekly email calendar is your best model: it names your responsibility, the cadence and the 120,000-subscriber list. Your trade show line also gives a recruiter something concrete to hold onto. The dates are easy to follow until the most recent role ends.
